title: drift-check compares DNA rules and gates with DriftEngine instead of comparing state against a DNA baseline

environment.workingTree: changes uncommitted; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy performed

before.implementation: packages/cli/src/cli.ts compared `state.selectedDna`/`state.currentStep` with top-level keys of `.behavioros/baseline.json`
before.baselineShape: `diff` writes a map of DNA file stems to parsed DNA documents, so `baseline.selectedDna` and `baseline.currentStep` are undefined
before.consequence: The result was a false drift every time a diff baseline was used, and governance rules/quality gates were never compared.

modes: DNA map baseline from `diff`: compares every dnas/*.yaml snapshot with DriftEngine, reports added/removed patterns and rule/gate additions, removals and changes.
Legacy state baseline (`selectedDna`/`currentStep`): still compares those fields field by field.
after.exitCodes: 0 when the snapshots match, 1 when drift is detected or the baseline/YAML is invalid.
after.tests: 13 new cases in packages/cli/tests/drift.test.ts (2 files / 14 cases in the CLI package).

fix.kind: bug fix with an extracted, testable drift module

changes.change: new: DNA snapshot loader, DriftEngine wrapper, legacy state comparison, runDriftCheck
drift-check now calls runDriftCheck; prints findings; exits 1 on drift or invalid input
new: 13 cases covering identical, changed, significant, added/removed, legacy state, invalid baseline and invalid YAML
documents DriftEngine comparison and exit code 1 on drift
C6 marked closed with the measured test count

regressionProof.preFix: The old command compared state fields to a DNA map; no test asserted the comparison and the CLI had 1 trivial case.
regressionProof.postFix: 13 unit/integration cases fail if the DriftEngine comparison, added/removed detection, legacy state path or invalid input handling regresses.

cases: matching snapshot: exit 0, 'No drift detected. 1 DNA pattern(s) match the baseline.'
changed rule action block -> warn: exit 1, 'Drift in sample: 0 rule(s) added, 0 removed, 1 changed...'
legacy state baseline: exit 1, 'DNA pattern changed' and 'Protocol step changed'

limitations: DriftEngine's contract covers governance rules and quality gates; persona, workflow and metadata changes are not flagged by design.
A baseline still has to be created by `behavioros diff`; drift-check does not create it.
Docker is not installed in this environment, so the container image was not built or run.
Release automation remains human-gated and unverified; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy was performed.
notDone: git commit, merge, push, tag, publish or deploy
